meta_description: A.I.B Painting and Decorating Services in Southampton. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and finishing work. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Local Painter & Decorator — Quality Finishes Guaranteed
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior transformation, we deliver professional results on time and on budget.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior redecoration to external rendering and weatherproofing—tailored to your home and budget.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform your rooms with expert colour selection and flawless application. We prepare surfaces properly, choose durable paints, and leave your home pristine—no mess, no shortcuts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Protect and refresh your property's outside. We tackle weathered woodwork, render, and masonry with trade-grade paints that resist Southampton's coastal weather for years.

services.title: Woodwork & Door Finishing
services.desc: Bring tired skirting, architraves, doors and frames back to life. We sand, prime and finish with precision to give your home a polished, cohesive look.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper application or professional removal and surface prep. We handle tricky angles, pattern matching, and old adhesive removal so your walls are ready for whatever comes next.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Keep your business looking sharp. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption, delivering consistent, durable finishes that impress clients and staff.

services.title: Prep, Repairs & Protection
services.desc: Proper groundwork makes the difference. We fill cracks, repair plaster, sand surfaces, and protect your furniture and floors—no cutting corners on preparation.

about_pullquote: A coat of paint shouldn't be rushed—or left to chancers.
about_para_1: A.I.B Painting and Decorating was founded on a simple idea: homeowners in Southampton deserve decorating that's done properly, on time, and without fuss. Over 12 years, we've built our reputation on meticulous prep work, colour expertise, and honest pricing. Every job—whether a single bedroom or a full exterior—gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're the safest choice. Our customers return because we show up when we say we will, we explain our work clearly, and we take pride in leaving your home looking brilliant. We've earned hundreds of recommendations across Bitterne, Millbrook, and the wider Southampton area—and that means everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About A.I.B

reviews.text: Had the whole house redecorated inside and out. The lads were tidy, professional and finished on time. Cost was fair and they didn't try to upsell unnecessary work. Really pleased—would definitely have them back.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed my living room done urgently before Christmas. Got a quote same day, started the following week. The colour advice was spot on and the finish is immaculate. No mess, no drama. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Christine L.

reviews.text: Exterior was looking rough after years of weather. A.I.B stripped, repaired and repainted everything. They explained every step and came in on budget. Five months on and it still looks fresh. Top job.
reviews.author: David H.
